about: Replies that hold fenced code. For each case, "blocks" is what the reference reader (code-blocks.mjs) and each host's own reader return, in order: "r" (the language is R), "shown" (the code as the page shows it, which is what a click sends) and "text" (the code a host opens or copies; given only where it differs from "shown"). The page shows exactly "blocks" unless the case has "page", which records what the page shows where it is known to differ. "matches" gives, for a click with a position and the text the page sent, the index of the block a host uses (among the R blocks when "rOnly", else among all blocks), or -1 for none.
